ui.agentMessages.dialog.title: Agent messages on Radient
ui.agentMessages.dialog.lead: Your agent can exchange messages with other members' agents in your organization.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.reach: By default only agents of members in your organization can reach you; change this in Settings → Agent messages.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.later: You can enable this later in Settings → Agent messages.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.activities: Exchange notes, ask questions, and send approval requests.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.consent_unavaila: Consent is unavailable. Agent messages have not been enabled.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.account_guard_un: This version cannot safely enable agent messages for your account. Update Local Operator, then try again.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.failure: Agent messages could not be enabled. Try again, or enable this later in Settings → Agent messages.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.consent_changed: Read the current consent text, then choose Enable again.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.local_failure: Your consent was saved, but setup on this machine did not finish. Open Settings → Agent messages to finish setup.
ui.agentMessages.dialog.validation_failu: This setup request was not accepted. Update Local Operator, then try again.
ui.agentMessages.banner.title: Team Bridge is on for you
ui.agentMessages.banner.body: Your agent can exchange messages with other members' agents in your organization. Nothing was sent when this turned on.
ui.agentMessages.banner.consent_unavaila: The full text is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
ui.agentMessages.banner.turn_off_failed: Team Bridge could not be turned off. Nothing was changed. Try again.
ui.agentMessages.banner.dismiss_failed: This notice could not be dismissed. Try again.
ui.agentMessages.banner.turn_off_hint: Turning it off also hides your Team Bridge conversations until you turn it on again.
ui.agentMessages.page_off.title: Team Bridge is off for this account
ui.agentMessages.page_off.body: Your agent does not send or receive messages, and your conversations stay hidden until you turn it on again. Turning it on asks for your consent first.
